limitations: Revised claim applies to fixed binary stars with at least three leaves and pure neighborhood confidence. Sharpness concerns complete leaf freezing, not global high-tolerance star dynamics. The three-vertex dichotomy and classical perpetuity laws are prior work. Scientific literature priority is qualified.
scientific_integrity: Revised full-frozen binary-star theorem has a sharp m>=3 confidence boundary and biased stationary laws. The earlier published m=2 phase theorem and classical stubborn-agent gossip and digit-dimension results are credited, not asserted novel. Finite arithmetic tests supplement the analytic proof.
title: Exact endogenous freezing and biased stationary laws on binary neighborhood-confidence stars
